patterns.note: Full-width sections with content constrained to a central max-width container, often featuring large, immersive background images or videos.
A sophisticated dark theme with dominant deep greys and blacks, contrasted by crisp white text and strategic use of a muted dark blue/purple accent and occasional light beige section backgrounds.
Consistent use of a single modern sans-serif font family across all text, with large, bold headlines for impact and smaller, lighter weights for body copy and uppercase labels.
Key sections feature large background images that remain fixed in the viewport, creating a parallax scrolling effect as foreground content moves over them.
The main navigation bar transitions from a static position to a sticky, slightly condensed state with a solid background after initial scroll.
Alternating section styles, often switching between dark backgrounds with light text and light backgrounds with dark text, or immersive image backgrounds.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and adds a background color after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Achieve a parallax effect by setting large background images to 'fixed' attachment, allowing foreground content to scroll over them, creating a sense of depth.
Integrate Lottie animations for subtle, engaging micro-interactions within UI elements, such as animated arrows or icons, to provide visual feedback or draw attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Impactful, large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and even smaller uppercase labels for categories or meta-information.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and images, creating a soft but modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more balanced density within card grids.

standout: The site distinguishes itself through the sophisticated use of immersive, fixed background images that create a subtle parallax effect for key sections, lending a premium and dynamic feel. This, combined with a dark, elegant color palette and subtle Lottie animations for UI elements, elevates it beyond a generic template.
